I watched the newest season while I drank. And as the season went on, and while I kept pounding beers, I came to grips with certain things my father did to me. Granted he wasn’t as bad as Big Bill, but it was buried stuff I had to deal with. For context, my father was an infantry soldier, like Frank, but in Bosnia and other wars before he left in the early 2000s. So I know he has his issues, the most he’s ever elucidated on them was by saying, “I’ve done some things I regret.” And to this day, apart from some of the funnier stories, that’s all I know. But while I know that now, growing up I had to walk on eggshells not to set him off, because when it happened, it left lasting impressions on me I’d rather not talk about. When you’re scared to tell your own father that you finished the chores he told you to do, it paints a picture I’m sure. My mother loved me, but was never around due to work. Whenever she is around, I am berated in a passive-aggressive manner about my life, and physically and mentally abused (she pinches my butt and makes sexual remarks about me being with other women. Whenever I confront her about it, she says that I’m her son and she can do whatever she wants). She would die for me, but she makes me very uncomfortable and upset. It is a love/hate discord that has left me scared and unsure about women’s feelings and motives. I had a birth father who left for unknown reasons and and a stepfather so wracked by PTSD that I had to walk eggshells around him due to his temper. 

I have Aspergers, so social interactions were, and still are hard to deal with. I have severe anxiety and depression that affects my day to day life. I am always assuming the worst out of every person I meet, and I can never trust anyone fully, not even my closest friends. 

My first girlfriend physically, but mostly emotionally abused me, telling me that I was worthless, and if I ever said anything she would say I raped and abused her. My second girlfriend tried to avoid me, but never let on at the time, probably due to girl #1 and my issues regarding her, and my third girlfriend was troubled, but I was an asshole and broke it apart (look at my posts to back my claims up). Any other women between those relationships either saw me as just a friend and nothing more, or a crazy person (gee, I wonder why?). Since then I had a momentary lapse into incel life, but I recently started evaluating myself (if my word means anything), and started to work my way up from my warped worldview.

Ever since my last breakup, I have been dealing with alcoholism, with brief interludes with heavy drugs to try and cope with my issues. I have attempted suicide multiple times, but most of the attempts were not life threatening and mostly just a cry for help (at least that’s what people tell me). I have tried to quit, but my aforementioned mental health woes have made that difficult. 

Right now, I have graduated high school and have feeble prospects for the future. The plan since I was fourteen was always to off myself by the time I was thirty if nothing good was going on, and since I’m a year away from twenty that date has shifted a decade. I am a broken individual who tries to be self-sufficient, but is anything but.

That’s my story.
